description: Test suite for the ReLU GPU kernel implementation within TensorFlow Lite's GPU delegate for Metal. Contains unit tests verifying different ReLU configurations such as no clip, with clip, with alpha, and alpha with clip.

classes.name: ReLUTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ReLU GPU kernel tests using XCTest framework.

methods.name: testReLUNoClipNoAlpha
methods.description: Tests the ReLU operation with no clipping and no alpha parameters.

methods.name: testReLUClip
methods.description: Tests the ReLU operation with clipping enabled.

methods.name: testReLUAlpha
methods.description: Tests the ReLU operation with alpha parameter enabled.

methods.name: testReLUAlphaClip
methods.description: Tests the ReLU operation with both alpha and clipping enabled.
